name: clevr
description: CLEVR is a synthetic visual question answering dataset designed to evaluate compositional and relational visual reasoning. It contains rendered scenes with multiple objects and programmatically generated questions that test counting, comparisons, and attribute queries which require multi-step reasoning. The benchmark focuses on measuring a model's compositional reasoning ability on synthetic scenes rather than natural-image understanding.
typical_sota_score: high — many models achieve ≈95–99% overall accuracy on standard CLEVR splits; some subtasks approach saturation
reputation: Widely adopted in the vision and VQA communities as a standard benchmark for compositional visual reasoning.
